config.design: Same H692 architecture, initialization seeds and batch streams. Train exact expected reconstruction-plus-count cost over all16patterns under independent Bernoulli probabilities; original0.01cost, no teacher labels or straight-through gradient. Select checkpoint every100steps by validation reconstruction-plus-count objective, as H692. Evaluate held combinations only after selection.
config.limitations: Frozen representation originally learned with supplied gates. Not joint unsupervised learning. Stochastic expected objective differs from hard-threshold evaluation; factorized gate distribution. Extra exact-search compute. Only three seeds and one teacher.
